<meta name="description" content="Test Copilot SDK applications with a language-neutral runtime image and Testcontainers."/>
<script>
  (() => {
    const param = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("theme");
    const modes = ["system", "light", "dark"];
    let saved;
    try {
      saved = window.localStorage.getItem("copilot-docs-theme");
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("Saved documentation theme is unavailable; using the URL or system preference.", error);
    }
    const mode = modes.includes(param) ? param : modes.includes(saved) ? saved : "system";
    const theme = mode === "system"
      ? (window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light")
      : mode;
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme-mode", mode);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  })();
</script>
<style>
:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --cp-bg: #f7f4ef;
  --cp-bg-elevated: #fcfbf8;
  --cp-surface: #ffffff;
  --cp-surface-soft: #f5f5f5;
  --cp-border: #dedede;
  --cp-border-strong: #919191;
  --cp-text: #242424;
  --cp-text-muted: #5c5c5c;
  --cp-text-soft: #6f6f6f;
  --cp-accent: #b11f4b;
  --cp-accent-hover: #9a1a41;
  --cp-accent-soft: rgba(177, 31, 75, 0.08);
  --cp-accent-fg: #ffffff;
  --cp-success: #16a34a;
  --cp-danger: #dc2626;
  --cp-warning: #f59e0b;
  --cp-link: #0078d4;
  --cp-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --cp-overlay: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  --cp-panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  --cp-panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  --cp-sheen: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  --cp-highlight: rgba(177, 31, 75, 0.12);
  --cp-syntax-keyword: var(--cp-accent);
  --cp-syntax-comment: var(--cp-text-soft);
  --cp-syntax-string: #21673b;
  --cp-syntax-number: #875000;
  --cp-syntax-function: #155a8a;
}
html[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --cp-bg: #3d3b3a;
  --cp-bg-elevated: #343231;
  --cp-surface: #292929;
  --cp-surface-soft: #2e2e2e;
  --cp-border: #474747;
  --cp-border-strong: #5f5f5f;
  --cp-text: #dedede;
  --cp-text-muted: #919191;
  --cp-text-soft: #b0b0b0;
  --cp-accent: #fd8ea1;
  --cp-accent-hover: #fb7b91;
  --cp-accent-soft: rgba(253, 142, 161, 0.14);
  --cp-accent-fg: #1a1a1a;
  --cp-success: #4ade80;
  --cp-danger: #f87171;
  --cp-warning: #fbbf24;
  --cp-link: #4da6ff;
  --cp-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
  --cp-overlay: rgba(41, 41, 41, 0.88);
  --cp-panel: rgba(41, 41, 41, 0.72);
  --cp-panel-strong: rgba(41, 41, 41, 0.96);
  --cp-sheen: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  --cp-highlight: rgba(253, 142, 161, 0.12);
  --cp-syntax-keyword: var(--cp-accent);
  --cp-syntax-comment: var(--cp-text-soft);
  --cp-syntax-string: #91d6a7;
  --cp-syntax-number: #e5bd83;
  --cp-syntax-function: #8fc7eb;
}
</style>
<script defer="defer" src="./js/vendor/highlight-11.12.0.min.js"></script>
